chapter_00.title: The Next Generation
chapter_00.narrator_01: Long ago, people looked up at the stars and wondered: will we ever get there?
chapter_00.narrator_02: They imagined other worlds, drew maps of the sky, and dreamed of big journeys.
chapter_00.narrator_03: Little by little, those dreams became discoveries.
chapter_00.narrator_04: In a future a lot like ours, people began to travel farther and farther from Earth.
chapter_00.narrator_05: We built homes in space, called space stations, and set up a base on the Moon.
chapter_00.narrator_06: And now, on Mars, the red planet, the first explorers were taking their very first steps.
chapter_00.narrator_07: But every new place brought new challenges. Future explorers would need to study hard, stay curious, and be brave.
chapter_00.narrator_08: And somewhere on Earth, a new group of explorers was already getting ready.
chapter_00.cosmo_01: Ada, you've been studying for almost 4 hours.
chapter_00.cosmo_02: Your break was supposed to start 47 minutes ago.
chapter_00.cosmo_03: You said that two chapters ago.
chapter_00.vera_01: I think you should take a little break.
chapter_00.ada_04: Vera! How long have you been there?
chapter_00.vera_02: Long enough to see you losing an argument to your own robot.
chapter_00.vera_03: Is it for your astronaut test?
chapter_00.ada_06: Yes. If I pass, I move on to the next part of my training.
chapter_00.vera_04: Then why do you keep reading the same page over and over?
chapter_00.ada_07: Because my brain decided to go on vacation.
chapter_00.vera_05: Why don't you ask COSMO for a practice test? It's a test just for training.
chapter_00.ada_08: Because I already know what I need to study.
chapter_00.cosmo_04: A practice test shows what you already know and what you still need to review.
chapter_00.vera_06: See? Even COSMO agrees with me.
chapter_00.cosmo_05: I can make one with questions about what you're studying.
chapter_00.ada_09: Okay. Let's see what I remember.
chapter_00.cosmo_06: Practice test ready! The questions are about space, planets, and space travel.
chapter_00.cosmo_07: Take your time, Ada. Making mistakes is part of learning.

chapter_01.title: The Surprise Passenger
chapter_01.narrator_01: The test room door opens. Ada steps into the hallway and stretches. She's tired.
chapter_01.narrator_02: Ada runs to the hangar, the big building where the spaceships are kept. Warning lights flash everywhere.
chapter_01.narrator_03: Ada climbs into the cockpit. The ship's lights and screens turn on all around her.
chapter_01.narrator_04: The ship reaches orbit. Far below, Ada can see Earth's oceans and clouds.
chapter_01.cosmo_01: Congratulations, Ada! You finished the practice test. Now it's time to rest.
chapter_01.cosmo_02: I just got a very strange alert.
chapter_01.cosmo_03: Your sister Vera's tracker just showed up inside a cargo ship.
chapter_01.cosmo_04: And that ship is about to leave for Mars.
chapter_01.cosmo_05: I'm sorry. The signal really is coming from Vera's device.
chapter_01.cosmo_06: The cameras show she went into the cargo area about 20 minutes ago.
chapter_01.cosmo_07: And the launch countdown has already started.
chapter_01.cosmo_08: Emergency call sent. The team here on Earth is trying to stop the ship.
chapter_01.cosmo_09: The cargo ship has taken off. Mission control confirmed it: there's a hidden passenger on board.
chapter_01.cosmo_10: There's a training ship here. But it wasn't built for long trips to other planets.
chapter_01.cosmo_11: Yes. Orbit means going around and around Earth without falling down. To do that, going up isn't enough: the ship has to go very fast sideways.
chapter_01.cosmo_12: Great! Then it's time to show me.
chapter_01.cosmo_13: Systems on! First, let's get into orbit around Earth.
chapter_01.cosmo_14: Right. Keep an eye on the ship's height and speed.
chapter_01.cosmo_15: We did it! We're going around Earth. Great job, Ada!
chapter_01.cosmo_16: Her ship is heading to Mars. We need to plan this chase carefully.
chapter_01.ada_01: Finally! I think I used every brain cell I have.
chapter_01.ada_02: Please tell me it's not another test.
chapter_01.ada_04: COSMO. Tell me Vera is not on that ship.
chapter_01.ada_05: HOW DID SHE EVEN GET IN THERE?!
chapter_01.ada_07: Call mission control! They have to stop the launch!
chapter_01.ada_11: I know how orbits work, COSMO.
chapter_01.ada_12: And then we catch up with Vera's ship.
chapter_01.ada_13: Okay. Let's go get my sister.

chapter_02.title: Arrival at Mars
chapter_02.narrator_01: Mars grows bigger in the window. The ground is red, and the air there is very thin.
chapter_02.narrator_02: The cargo ship drops the capsule toward the ground of Mars. Ada gets ready to follow it.
chapter_02.narrator_03: Ada reaches the spot where the rover landed. The robot is sitting among rocks and red dust.
chapter_02.narrator_04: Ada disconnects from the rover and gets ready to go back to her ship.
chapter_02.narrator_05: Back on her ship, Ada takes off and leaves Mars behind.
chapter_02.narrator_06: Mars gets smaller and smaller behind them. Somewhere far ahead, Vera's journey continues.
chapter_02.cosmo_01: We're getting close to Mars, the fourth planet from the Sun.
chapter_02.cosmo_02: Yes. It's starting to go around Mars.
chapter_02.cosmo_03: I don't think so. But it's getting ready to drop a capsule down to the ground.
chapter_02.cosmo_04: It looks like the ship is carrying a robot explorer.
chapter_02.cosmo_05: Yes. A rover is a robot car that explores other planets.
chapter_02.cosmo_06: Maybe. The rover probably saved information about the trip, and it could show the ship's next stop. But I'm not sure.
chapter_02.cosmo_07: Ada, remember: that rover isn't ours.
chapter_02.cosmo_08: Hmm. I don't think the rules agree with you.
chapter_02.cosmo_09: The capsule has started going down.
chapter_02.cosmo_10: Not much. The cargo ship is already getting ready to leave.
chapter_02.cosmo_11: I can connect to the rover, but we have to get close to it.
chapter_02.cosmo_12: First, something important: gravity on Mars is different.
chapter_02.cosmo_13: Gravity is the force that pulls everything down to the ground. On Mars, it pulls much less than on Earth.
chapter_02.cosmo_14: Exactly! On Mars, a scale would show just over a third of your weight. You don't change at all: Mars just pulls less.
chapter_02.cosmo_15: And with less gravity, you jump much higher. Be careful not to jump too far and miss your landing!
chapter_02.cosmo_16: I'll help you the whole way.
chapter_02.cosmo_17: Well done! You used Mars's weak gravity to get here.
chapter_02.cosmo_19: I found the cargo ship's name and the messages it sent during the delivery.
chapter_02.cosmo_20: Maybe. The messages talk about another delivery after Mars. I'll compare them with the navigation maps.
chapter_02.cosmo_21: Found it! The ship's next stop is near Saturn.
chapter_02.cosmo_22: To be exact, Titan, Saturn's biggest moon.
chapter_02.cosmo_23: Robots don't joke while they're calculating routes.
chapter_02.cosmo_24: Well, first we need to confirm which path the ship will take.
chapter_02.cosmo_25: Very! More than 1 billion kilometers. Even light, the fastest thing there is, takes more than 1 hour to get there.
chapter_02.cosmo_26: Yes. And our messages to Earth also travel at the speed of light. The farther we go, the longer they'll take to arrive.
chapter_02.cosmo_27: It depends on the route and the engine. With today's spaceships, the trip to Saturn takes several years.
chapter_02.cosmo_28: Yes. And we'd still need to slow down carefully when we get there.
chapter_02.cosmo_29: I know. We'll have to find another way.
chapter_02.cosmo_31: On our current path, we won't catch the ship before its next stop.
chapter_02.cosmo_32: It was built to study the ground and rocks of Mars.
chapter_02.cosmo_33: I don't know how to measure fun.

chapter_02.cosmo_36: Not on our current path. We'll need another idea.

chapter_02.ada_02: So is it going to land?
chapter_02.ada_05: Wait... COSMO, do you think that rover knows where the ship is going?
chapter_02.ada_07: We're not stealing it. Just borrowing it.

chapter_02.ada_09: We need to reach that rover before the ship disappears.

chapter_02.ada_19: Can we tell where it's going?
chapter_02.ada_20: Please tell me you found something.

chapter_02.ada_29: We don't have years, COSMO. Vera is on that ship.
